text: ∀x (Waterfall(x) → (NaturalFeature(x) ∧ (∃y (WaterFlows(y) ∧ OverVerticalDrop(y) ∧ AssociatedWith(x, y))) ∧ (∃z (OftenFoundIn(x, z) ∧ (MountainousArea(z) ∨ River(z)))))) ::: A waterfall is a natural feature where water flows over a vertical drop or a series of steep drops, often found in mountainous areas or along rivers.
